title: the bash superclaude is retired: its callers and proofs move to superclaude.py and the retire door deletes it
intention: cairn/devices/cc/superclaude (the bash) no longer exists: nothing runs it, every proof that ran it measures superclaude.py, and `cairn codemother retire` deleted it with no caller named.
why: Child 6 of c3cd232ba0cf; outline 10.3.2.1 says superclaude is Python on every box. Measured 2026-11-23 at origin/main ee12953c6: the retire machine's namers() lists 20 files naming the bash; children 1941e93b25a3 (the port) and 0b7a3f1d53f0 (bin/cairn dispatch) are PROVED, so bin/cairn no longer starts the bash on any box, and two launchers beside each other drift.
traces_to: Law 1 (a settled answer is not re-derived: two launchers is two answers); Law 4 (the retire door finds the callers by running proofs); outline 10.3.2.1.
how: Repoint the two callers; repoint or retire each bash-running proof (mapping in the decisions); write one proof that the bash is gone and nothing names it as live; run `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` on Linux; fix the wording of the charters and comments. The build is a Linux hand's, in that order.

clauses.claim: cc/0/bin/restart and recovery/bootstrap.sh name cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py and no longer name the bash path

each proof that ran the bash reads green against superclaude.py (sets_cairn_user, wire, memory_scope, tmux_mode launcher teeth, test_bootstrap launch teeth, ground_loop_survives_its_caller, the unit-of-a-run proof, launchers_moved, the floor-link and instance-wiring proofs, the cairn device launcher, the learning_block holder tooth), and test_superclaude_bare_box.py is retired with its teeth named
`cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` exits RETIRED on Linux with no CALLER and the file is absent
no charter, outline piece or comment under cairn/ names the bash path as a live launcher

decisions.text: D1: repoint the two callers. cairn/devices/cc/0/bin/restart:55 sets LAUNCHER to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py (run through the venv python, as bin/cairn does); recovery/bootstrap.sh:484-485 (cairn_wire_instances) links superclaude.py as the verb superclaude, the way bin/cairn.py _wire_instances already does.

D2: repoint the cc proofs to superclaude.py. sets_cairn_user (5 teeth), wire (3), the three launcher teeth of tmux_mode (lines 159-177; its other nine do not touch the bash) and memory_scope's in-situ pty arm keep their teeth with the launcher path set to the .py; the replacement for the dry-run semantics is tooth 1 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python, for the memory scope tooth 8. A tooth the .py cannot satisfy is a FIXME to the builder, never a weakening.

D3: repoint the other proofs that run or read the bash: test_bootstrap (its two launch teeth, 222 and 236), test_ground_loop_survives_its_caller, test_a_unit_a_test_run_starts_is_the_runs, test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices (its tooth_scripts_parse_and_locate and tooth_no_live_reference move to the .py), bin's floor-link and instance-wiring proofs (the verb link now targets the .py), the cairn device's launcher proof, and the learning_block holder tooth (line 142 reads the bash for `--holder`; it reads the .py for its trace call). The held-instance proof test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py is NOT here: ticket b33cc7d29c45 owns it.

D4: retire test_superclaude_bare_box.py whole (4 teeth: askpass serves only what is held, a held password is guidance never text, an absent claude would be installed, no password never hangs). Replacement: tooth 7 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python (no sudo, no password prompt, never elevates) covers the first two and the last as their absence. REPLACEMENT for 'an absent claude would be installed': ticket 8219a855a7c1 gives superclaude.py its install branch and its proof cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_installs_an_absent_claude.py (4 teeth, sealed green on Windows); this ticket depends on 8219a855a7c1 landing first and drops nothing.

D5: one new proof, one tooth per falsifier clause 1, 3 and 4 (red first): the two callers name the .py; the bash path is absent from the tree; no live file names it as a launcher. Clause 2 is the repointed proofs' own seals. Then run `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` on Linux, which deletes the bash when no caller turns red.

D6: fix the wording that names the bash as the launcher: the cc, recovery and launch charters, outline piece 05-cairn-device.md, the shim and probe comments, and the docstrings of the three proofs that only mention it.

D7: d423852d0a68's proof drops two files from its TEN list: cairn/devices/cc/proofs/test_superclaude_bare_box.py (deleted by D4) and cairn/devices/recovery/proofs/test_launchers_moved_to_their_devices.py (D3 runs superclaude.py through sys.executable there, so its bash_script_argv import has no use and is deleted, never kept as a shim). A comment beside the list names e179281f6eff as why the two left, and a line in the docstring says the list shrinks only when a listed file leaves the repo or stops running a bash script. Its PROVES key and both teeth are unchanged; its seal is resealed in the build. d423 is not in cairn/machines/corrosion/constraint_set.json nor codemother's copy.

D8: superclaude.py's boot log writes to env CAIRN_BOOT_LOG when it is set, else to $HOME/.cairn/logs/boot/superclaude.log as today: the bash's existing contract (superclaude:311, CAIRN_LOGTARGET=${CAIRN_BOOT_LOG:-...}), kept by name. Its falsifier is test_superclaude_memory_scope.py's two boot-log teeth (scope: declined by SUPERCLAUDE_NO_SCOPE; scope: MemoryHigh=...), which read a scratch CAIRN_BOOT_LOG so a proof launch never writes the live boot log. The same edit rewords line 4 ('Ported from the shell launcher beside it') for D6.

D9: test_no_cc_proof_spawns_a_bare_bash.py's tooth 2 (ticket f2a3b90c2931) read EDITED = test_tmux_mode.py as needing a _BASH head; the repoint left it spawning superclaude.py under sys.executable and no bash, so the tooth redded with nothing to name. Tooth 2 now reds an edited proof that spawns a bash (argv head 'bash' or a *BASH* name) without a _BASH head, and passes one that spawns none. Measured: it reds when test_tmux_mode.py is given a bash-named argv head, green as built (2026-11-23, wt-e179).

D10: test_a_test_run_unit_is_collected_when_it_fails.py (ticket 7bb0d4894a62, landed after wt-e179's base ef541167c) cited the bash by path in its docstring, so the gone-proof's test_nothing_live_names_the_bash redded in the house. The citation keeps its commit pin and line numbers and drops the path; no tooth changes.

orient.intent: Retire the bash launcher cairn/devices/cc/superclaude: repoint its two live callers (cc/0/bin/restart, recovery/bootstrap.sh's instance wiring) and every proof that runs or reads it to cairn/devices/cc/superclaude.py, retire the one proof whose subject leaves with it (test_superclaude_bare_box.py, replaced by tooth 7 of test_superclaude_runs_from_python and 8219a855a7c1's install proof), keep the bash's CAIRN_BOOT_LOG contract in the .py, fix wording that names the bash as a launcher, and have `cairn codemother retire cairn/devices/cc/superclaude` delete it on Linux with no caller turning red.
orient.scope: IN: the 29 bounds.in paths of ticket e179281f6eff (two callers, 12 repointed proofs, one retired proof, one new proof, the bash itself, superclaude.py's boot-log path, charter/outline/comment wording, d423852d0a68's TEN list). OUT: bin/cairn.py (already dispatches the .py, 0b7a3f1d53f0); test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py (b33cc7d29c45 owns it); test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py (the replacement, read only); the bin/cairn and bin/cairn.cmd shims; the .py's Windows branches.
unknowns: whether every repointed proof's teeth hold against the .py on Linux unchanged (a tooth the .py cannot satisfy is a FIXME, never a weakening)
whether the retire door's namers() list at today's main still equals the 20 files measured at ee12953c6
the build touches proofs in five components (cc, recovery, bin, cairn, learning_block, base, bus_client, launch): each reseal is its own run, and none is under cairn/devices/tester/

constraints.text: superclaude is Python on every box, launched by the platform shell, and never elevates itself (outline 10.3.2.1)
the bash is deleted only by the retire door: a namer's proof turning red restores the target byte for byte and exits 1 (retire charter falsifier clauses 1-2)
a tooth the .py cannot satisfy is a FIXME to the builder, never a weakening (ticket D2); a deterministic red is fixed or carries an answered question (CLAUDE.md bugs, corrosion)
test_a_launch_moves_off_a_held_instance.py is owned by b33cc7d29c45 and stays out; bin/cairn.py and test_superclaude_runs_from_python.py are read only
Rule 1 encapsulation: proofs measure only their own component; code in one device does not import another device's code except a published tool
each repointed proof reseals in its own component, and a commit under cairn/devices/tester/ is a tester-suite reseal (one at a time, asked of the integrator); this build writes nothing there
superclaude.py keeps the bash's boot-log contract by name: CAIRN_BOOT_LOG when set, else $HOME/.cairn/logs/boot/superclaude.log (D8)

unknowns: the retire door's run of every namer's proof on Linux is the deciding measure; a proof a namer lacks reads unmeasured, not green
